binutils.status: package build occurred in fresh mmdebstrap customize hook; all package controls passed
binutils.test_harness_issue: scripts/build-ubuntu26-binutils-check.py uses plain unshare-helper chroot for functional/ISA tests without mounting dev/proc. No package regeneration in that test path; notify owner to repair future test entries.
binutils.interpretation: An unmounted persistent chroot can contain device placeholders; stored file observation alone is not a mounted-namespace inspection. Source entry omission plus written data shows the existing test harness needs correction.

systemd.initial_build_cause: Retained namespace re-entry omitted /dev remount; rules find stderr redirected to a regular /dev/null, then debhelper autotrigger copied that file as if it were empty.
systemd.replacement_observation: Updated build.sh now asserts character-device major/minor, null discard/read-empty, zero bytes and proc availability; actual .2 outputs still pending.
